verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS CRM like Salesmate, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, usage tracking, analytics opt-outs or privacy controls. The pack only documents CRM features, AI agents, pricing and API availability, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
